ValidationRule.description: When Case = Sales Offers Request & Sub Type = FOC Waiver, Corporate Scheme is mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( RecordTypeId = "01290000001UPUR", /*Sales Offers Request*/ ISPICKVAL ( Sub_Type__c , "FOC Qantas Club Waiver" ), OR ( ISPICKVAL ( Access_through__c , " "), ISBLANK ( AssetId ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For FOC Qantas Club Waiver, you will need to add the Corporate Scheme to this Case and fill up the Access Through picklist.
